theme.name: Phased, competitive Discover England funding with shared learning
theme.claim: The Discover England fund is delivered through phased bids, with larger consortium bids aligning public and private funding streams and a condition that learning is shared so successes can be replicated.

text.line: In May, phase one of the fund was launched and the first winners have now been announced.
We have launched the criteria for bigger bids of over £1 million.

Winning bids will ideally align investment in tourism and culture from a range of different private and public funding streams – for example, the Local Growth Fund, the Coastal Communities Fund, the Rural Development Programme for England (including LEADER), Arts Council England and the Heritage Lottery Fund – to support the development of a world class visitor experience. ** (Reference: 5)

references.reference: LEADER funding provides smaller amounts of funding to local businesses through the 80 LEADER action groups that have been established across the country.

theme.name: Piloting and industry partnership delivery
theme.claim: Measures such as the apprenticeship pilot and GREAT Rail itineraries are delivered by piloting with industry partners and then drawing on the results to shape wider approaches.

text.line: We are delighted to be working with a range of companies - including PGL, TUI, Merlin Entertainments, Eurocamp, Monarch Airlines and Parkdean Holidays, as well as colleges across the country to take this forward.
VisitBritain and the Rail Delivery Group have today launched a competition for ten people (five lucky pairs) to road- test these itineraries.
HM Treasury is carefully considering the responses received to the discussion paper and will respond in due course, setting out next steps.
